The '''Jhonterius worshippers''' were a small cult that formed following the appearance of the supposed [[Ghost of Jhonterius Park]], who claimed to be the spirit of [[Jhonterius]], founder of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[D'larah]]. They conducted evening vigils, and were generally peaceful.
